title: Stay With Us
content:
Take control of your health and wellbeing at our 55-acre tropical wellness retreat in West Palm Beach, Florida. Explore our unparalleled Programs and Passports for the ultimate, personalized wellness experience. Discover our Programs & Passports

Tripadvisor rating:

Start your journey to wellness:

  • 70 YEARS OF UNMATCHED HISTORY AS THE PIONEERS OF HEALTH & LONGEVITY
  • RELAX AT OUR PRIVATE, ECO-FRIENDLY, 55-ACRE TROPICAL RETREAT IN WEST PALM BEACH, FLORIDA
  • COMPREHENSIVE TESTING & DATA ANALYSIS TO OPTIMIZE YOUR HEALTH & WELLBEING
  • NOURISH & REPLENISH WITH OUR SIGNATURE ORGANIC, ENZYME-RICH PLANT FOOD CUISINE & ALKALIZING ELIXIRS
  • PREVENT OR REVERSE SERIOUS HEALTH CONDITIONS ON A CHEMICAL-FREE, WALKING CAMPUS
  • REGENERATE YOUR WHOLE BODY WITH INNOVATIVE PROGRAMS, PASSPORTS, & PERSONALIZED PROTOCOLS

Design your path to optimal health & longevity

Reclaim optimal wellbeing at Hippocrates Wellness, the original pioneers of health and longevity for 70 years. Our personalized Wellness Programs and flexible Hippocrates Passports utilize cutting-edge technology alongside a progressive approach to help you achieve your health and fitness goals. Design your perfect wellbeing journey, tailored to suit your schedule and needs. Our world-leading experts, with decades of experience in nutrition, integrative health, and holistic and Western medicine, offer ground-breaking lectures, one-to-one consultations, and organic, enzyme-rich, plant-based cuisine. Experience life-changing therapies, advanced treatments, state-of-the-art facilities, and more in a stunning, eco-conscious, tranquil setting. Whether you're looking for a short visit or a longer, more immersive stay, our structured Programs and flexible Passports allow you to escape everyday stress and distractions to reset your mind, body, and spirit. Discover your ideal experience at Hippocrates Wellness today. We can't wait to meet you and help you transform your life! SPEAK TO A WELLNESS CONSULTANT >

Discover the perfect health journey for you

21 Days Whether you want to reverse or prevent serious health conditions or reset, reboot, and rebalance your body, mind, and spirit, the globally renowned Hippocrates Wellness Life Transformation Program is the ultimate experience for transforming your mental and physical wellbeing at any stage of life. Learn More 28 Days Our Comprehensive Cancer Wellness Program is based on a holistic approach to help you restore your metabolic health, up-regulate your immune system, and mobilize your vitality to accelerate healing and wellness. Hippocrates Wellness has a renowned international reputation for helping people from all over the world with cancer to restore their health. Learn More
